item.title: github: Block users from discussion comments in personal repositories
item.description:
GitHub added in-context blocking controls for discussion comments in repositories owned by personal accounts. Users can now block or unblock other users directly from discussion comments, matching the existing issue and pull request comment behavior.

  • Source: GitHub

item.title: github: Close all open contributions authored by a blocked user
item.description:
GitHub added an option to automatically close all open issues, discussions, and pull requests from a user when you block them from a personal account or organization. This applies to contributions authored by the blocked user at the time the block is set.

  • Source: GitHub
